content:
q17.

**`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`**

The memo CRUD operations (React Query hooks) live in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — it contains the list/get queries and create/update/delete mutations (`memoServiceClient.listMemos` at line 116, `.getMemo` at 146, `.createMemo` at 183, `.updateMemo` at 202, `.deleteMemo` at 258, plus memo-comment queries).

All of these go through `memoServiceClient`, the generated Connect service client created in `web/src/connect.ts:197`:

```ts
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```

where `MemoService` is the generated service definition imported from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`web/src/connect.ts:10`).
